summary: Convert a file: URL to an absolute platform path with Node percent-decoding, UNC, and separator validation.

requirements.input: string or WHATWG URL represented by compatible URL layer

semantics.percent_decoding: decodes valid path bytes including spaces/unicode
semantics.encoded_separators: encoded / or backslash forms rejected where Node rejects them
semantics.windows: handles drive letters and UNC hosts
semantics.security: decoded dot segments can become traversal and require separate validation by callers

caveats: new URL(...).pathname is not equivalent to fileURLToPath.
Do not treat this helper itself as a path traversal defense.

tests.name: normal encoded space
tests.expected_behavior: returns an absolute path containing 'hello world'

tests.name: edge percent and platform semantics
tests.expected_behavior: returns a Windows path beginning with C:\\
